Dolphin Cruise Aboard Dolphin Tales

Dolphin Cruise Aboard Dolphin Tales is an affordable and family-friendly way to see dolphins and other wildlife while aboard our eco-friendly cruises.

Our guests often catch a glimpse of local wildlife and other natural scenery of the beautiful back bay waters and our entire boat seating area is covered and includes padded seats and a bathroom for family-friendly comfort.

We are centrally located in Orange Beach, AL, a short drive from anywhere on Alabama’s Gulf Coast including the communities of Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Perdido Key, FL.

Best Dolphin Cruise!

"These guys are HANDS DOWN the very best when it comes to Dolphin Cruises! We didn't know that it was their only day off and yet they didn't want to disappoint us so they came in anyways. It was TOTALLY WORTH THE MONEY WE PAID and we will ONLY choose them again when we return next summer!"

– Johnny S. Tripadvisor
Fun Captain & First Mate!

"They just know where to find the dolphins! They also gave us some history about the surrounding area. Overall, it was a great experience, did not feel rushed, and we weren't crowded on the boat. I didn't think I was going to enjoy it, but I actually had a blast! They even gave us time to grab some last minute drinks for the morning cruise!"

– Derek I. Tripadvisor
The Customer Service!

"First off let me say, BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE ever! The day of the cruise, the weather was not the friendliest. Tabitha stayed in contact and when the weather permitted, told us that Captain Bart would be waiting for our arrival. Mr. Bart did his best to locate the dolphins, EVEN AFTER a RAINSTORM for our kids!"

– Latoya T. Tripadvisor
